executors.claude: claude -p --model 'opus[1m]' --permission-mode acceptEdits "You are executing a Stage work item. Read the selected card at $STAGE_WORK_ITEM_PATH and every ancestor card listed in $STAGE_WORK_ITEM_ANCESTOR_PATHS before acting; together they are the whole instruction. Work in $STAGE_PROJECT_ROOT. Do not commit. Do work needed for the card's purpose, including work outside its declared scope. Report every decision you make and every scope boundary crossing. Never edit the card's scope field: widening it is the human's call, and rewriting it erases the crossing you were asked to report. Skip work the purpose does not need without reporting it. When you judge the work item itself wrong, change nothing at all and report why, so a person can withdraw or redesign it. Before exiting, set the selected card's frontmatter 'promotion' to the actual final choice. Use 'not_applicable' only when the card owns no decision or only one-time venue exceptions; any other linked decision requires an explicit 'approved', 'deferred', or 'rejected' choice. After every declared promotion path has been written, use 'promoted' so the audit can distinguish choosing promotion from completing it. The shared work log is $STAGE_WORK_LOG_PATH. The latest reviewer verdict JSON, when present, is at $STAGE_REVIEW_VERDICT_FILE. For every criteria entry whose verdict is FAIL, disposition its exact criterion as accept, decline, or defer with a non-empty one-line reason. Put them in this attempt's executor report as Review dispositions (JSON): followed by one JSON-array line of objects with exactly finding, disposition, and reason; copy each criterion exactly and in order. Only when every failed criterion is declined or deferred with a reason may Changed paths (JSON) be empty. Before exiting, append exactly one section using this contract: ### Executor report, then non-empty single-line What changed:, Why:, Decisions made:, and Work not done: fields. Use None when there is nothing to report for a field. Then add Changed paths (JSON): followed by one JSON-array line. Changed paths (JSON) must contain every repository-relative path changed for this card across all attempts. Add optional required Review dispositions (JSON) as just specified, then a non-empty single-line Review request:. Append only; do not rewrite prior log content. The log owns per-attempt work, rationale, changed-path claims, dispositions, and review requests. The card owns durable lifecycle state and its Progress, Verification, Retrospective, and Promotion decision sections; do not duplicate log facts there."

reapers.codex: node --input-type=module -e "import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; const tool = '/Users/woogis/.claude/plugins/cache/openai-codex/codex/1.0.6/scripts/codex-companion.mjs'; const target = process.env.STAGE_WORK_ITEM_PATH; if (!target) { console.error('STAGE_WORK_ITEM_PATH is required'); process.exit(1); } const status = spawnSync(process.execPath, [tool, 'status', '--all', '--json'], { encoding: 'utf8' }); if (status.status !== 0) { process.stdout.write(status.stdout || ''); process.stderr.write(status.stderr || ''); process.exit(status.status || 1); } const jobs = (JSON.parse(status.stdout).running || []).filter((job) => job.request?.prompt?.includes(target)); let failed = false; for (const job of jobs) { const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, [tool, 'cancel', job.id], { encoding: 'utf8' }); process.stdout.write(result.stdout || ''); process.stderr.write(result.stderr || ''); failed ||= result.status !== 0; } if (failed) process.exitCode = 1;"
